summary: Strengthen crisis governance, escalation, and recovery reporting with practical ISO-aligned exercises. Explore the five-day advanced course.
lede: Crisis management training is for crisis leaders, continuity managers, and senior response coordinators who set escalation authority and guide response and recovery. Participants practise defining activation thresholds, assessing impacts and recovery priorities, documenting decisions, and coordinating incident teams and stakeholder communications. Exercises also cover status tracking and dashboard design, while AI-assisted analysis receives conceptual treatment.
audienceIntro: This advanced crisis management course is designed for professionals who set response authority, coordinate incident teams, or oversee continuity and recovery decisions. This course is designed for: Crisis Management Directors coordinating executive response and escalation decisions. Business Continuity Managers linking crisis priorities to continuity arrangements. Emergency Management Coordinators aligning incident teams and operational resources. Crisis Response Team Leaders directing actions against evolving incident information. Corporate Security Managers assessing threats and coordinating protective responses. Operational Resilience Leads connecting critical services with recovery priorities. Crisis Communications Managers preparing executive updates and stakeholder messages. Enterprise Risk Managers translating risk scenarios into crisis escalation triggers. IT Service Continuity Managers coordinating technology restoration during major disruption. Internal Audit Managers reviewing crisis governance records and decision controls.
prerequisites: Advanced course. Prior professional experience in crisis response, business continuity, operational resilience, emergency management, or enterprise risk is expected. You should be able to interpret organizational roles and operational impacts. Coding is not required; spreadsheet familiarity is useful for the Excel-based reporting exercise.
